description: A tool call, then a form elicitation scoped to it (toolCallId) that the client accepts with an server code, a short note, an AskUserQuestion-shaped array and a value holding a quote and a backslash; the call then echoes every value in its rawOutput (as values and as a key) and its content text, then in a rawOutput over the inline limit, and completes; end_turn. The host must log none of the values (0002, elicitation_resolved)

params.message: The search server needs your server code.

note: The echo of a made-up key, not a secret (gitleaks:allow)

content.text: Configured with sk-test-SECRET-123, note ok, schedules Fees.
